Card Q&A.a: No. Digivolve from the Tamer as such, and do not treat it as if it is a digivolving Digimon. Card Q&A.q: Does the digivolution requirement that this card digivolve from a Tamer mean the Tamer that becomes a digivolution card is treated as if it is a Digimon when digivolving?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you do.A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.
Card Q&A.q: Do I perform a digivolution bonus draw even if I digivolve from a Tamer?

Card Q&A.a: No, it can't. A card cannot attack on the turn it is played, even if it digivolves from a card placed on the field. It can only attack if it was not played that turn.
Card Q&A.q: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack this turn?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it is.If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.
